name: Royal County Down Golf Club -- Annesley Links
note: The shorter second links at Royal County Down (Annesley), remodelled by Mackenzie & Ebert in 2015 and sharing the clubhouse with the Championship course. No hole-by-hole scorecard is published on the club site and none was found corroborated elsewhere; no USGA course rating or slope published either. Both arrive with the first scorecard photo.
